# blitz-lsp: the language server for editors (tools/vscode has the extension for Visual Studio Code).
project(lsp)
add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME})
init_project(${PROJECT_NAME})
set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME blitz-lsp)

# blitz-format and blitz-tidy are programs; what they do is in these files, which the server uses as well. They go into libraries of
# their own because they and the compiler have headers of the same name (keywords.hpp, config.hpp).
set(_FORMAT "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/../code_format/source")
set(_TIDY "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/../code_tidy/source")
add_library(lsp_format STATIC "source/bridge.hpp" "source/bridge_tools.cpp" "${_FORMAT}/format.cpp" "${_FORMAT}/options.cpp")
init_project(lsp_format)
target_include_directories(lsp_format PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/source" "${_FORMAT}")
target_link_libraries(lsp_format PUBLIC tools)

add_library(lsp_tidy STATIC "source/bridge_tidy.cpp" "${_TIDY}/config.cpp" "${_TIDY}/engine.cpp" "${_TIDY}/rules.cpp")
init_project(lsp_tidy)
target_include_directories(lsp_tidy PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/source" "${_TIDY}")
target_link_libraries(lsp_tidy PUBLIC blitzfront tools)

target_sources(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
	"source/main.cpp"
	"source/json.hpp"
	"source/json.cpp"
	"source/document.hpp"
	"source/document.cpp"
	"source/commands.hpp"
	"source/commands.cpp"
	"source/server.hpp"
	"source/server.cpp"
)
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/source")
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE lsp_tidy lsp_format blitzfront tools)
target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE BLITZLLVM_VERSION="${CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION}")

# The commands, for hover and completion. Next to the executable for a build tree, in share/blitzllvm for an installation.
set(_COMMANDS "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tests/suite/functions.txt")
add_custom_command(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME} POST_BUILD
	COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${_COMMANDS}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${PROJECT_NAME}>/commands.txt")

install(TARGETS ${PROJECT_NAME} RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(FILES "${_COMMANDS}" DESTINATION bin RENAME commands.txt)
install(TARGETS ${PROJECT_NAME} RUNTIME DESTINATION bin COMPONENT system EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
install(FILES "${_COMMANDS}" DESTINATION share/blitzllvm RENAME commands.txt COMPONENT system EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

get_target_property(_SOURCES ${PROJECT_NAME} SOURCES)
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${_SOURCES})
